# FebBox

[FebBox](https://www.febbox.com/) is a cloud storage service.

## Configuration

Create an API client at <https://www.febbox.com/open/client>, then run:

```console
rclone config
```

Choose `febbox` and enter the client ID and client secret.

<!-- autogenerated options start - DO NOT EDIT - instead edit fs.RegInfo in backend/febbox/febbox.go and run make backenddocs to verify --> <!-- markdownlint-disable-line line-length -->
### Standard options

Here are the Standard options specific to febbox (FebBox).

#### --febbox-client-id

OAuth client ID.

Properties:

- Config:      client_id
- Env Var:     RCLONE_FEBBOX_CLIENT_ID
- Type:        string
- Required:    true

#### --febbox-client-secret

OAuth client secret.

Properties:

- Config:      client_secret
- Env Var:     RCLONE_FEBBOX_CLIENT_SECRET
- Type:        string
- Required:    true

### Advanced options

Here are the Advanced options specific to febbox (FebBox).

#### --febbox-list-chunk

Number of entries requested per page.

Properties:

- Config:      list_chunk
- Env Var:     RCLONE_FEBBOX_LIST_CHUNK
- Type:        int
- Default:     100

#### --febbox-endpoint

API endpoint.

Properties:

- Config:      endpoint
- Env Var:     RCLONE_FEBBOX_ENDPOINT
- Type:        string
- Default:     "https://api.febbox.com/oauth"

#### --febbox-encoding

The encoding for the backend.

See the [encoding section in the overview](/overview/#encoding) for more info.

Properties:

- Config:      encoding
- Env Var:     RCLONE_FEBBOX_ENCODING
- Type:        Encoding
- Default:     Slash,BackSlash,Del,Ctl,InvalidUtf8,Dot

#### --febbox-description

Description of the remote.

Properties:

- Config:      description
- Env Var:     RCLONE_FEBBOX_DESCRIPTION
- Type:        string
- Required:    false

## Backend commands

Here are the commands specific to the febbox backend.

Run them with:

```console
rclone backend COMMAND remote:
```

The help below will explain what arguments each command takes.

See the [backend](/commands/rclone_backend/) command for more
info on how to pass options and arguments.

These can be run on a running backend using the rc command
[backend/command](/rc/#backend-command).

### addurl

Add a file from an HTTP URL.

```console
rclone backend addurl remote: [options] [<arguments>+]
```

This command asks FebBox to ingest a file from an HTTP or HTTPS URL.

```console
rclone backend addurl febbox:path https://example.com/file
```

<!-- autogenerated options stop -->

## Adding files from URLs

The FebBox API accepts HTTP and HTTPS source URLs instead of file contents.
Use the backend command to ask FebBox to ingest a URL:

```console
rclone backend addurl febbox:path https://example.com/file
```

The command returns the FebBox task ID. Standard uploads such as `copy`,
`copyto`, `sync`, and `rcat` are not supported.

## Account limitations

Generating download URLs requires a FebBox premium account. On a free account,
listing and supported file-management operations remain available, but attempts
to read file contents return a permission-denied error.

Server-side copy also requires sufficient free space in the FebBox account.

## Modification times and hashes

FebBox reports modification times with one-second precision. FebBox hash types
are not documented, so this backend does not advertise hashes.
